 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full uniform rows and columns divide the grid into panels.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    def spans(size, separators):
        result = []
        start = 0
        for pos in separators:
            if pos > start:
                result.append((start, pos))
            start = pos + 1
        if start < size:
            result.append((start, size))
        return result

    row_spans = spans(h, sep_rows)
    col_spans = spans(w, sep_cols)
    cells = [grid[r][c]
             for r0, r1 in row_spans for c0, c1 in col_spans
             for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
    background = max(set(cells), key=cells.count)
    marker = next(color for color in set(cells) if color != background)

    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker
                      for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) == 2
             else background
             for c0, c1 in col_spans]
            for r0, r1 in row_spans]
"
